remarks: Perfect for investors or owner occupancy! Spacious 2,620 sq. ft. multi-family Home boasts three apartments with easy access to shopping, dining and trains. Fully updated ground level apartment showcases hardwood floors in an open plan living room and granite clad kitchen with stainless appliances, full bath and bedroom. Main level one-bedroom apartment, also completely updated and featuring hardwood floors, reveals living room, kitchen with granite-topped counters, stainless appliances, full bath. Great opportunity to customize the top two floors which consist of two-bedroom apartment with office, full bath, kitchen, living room and dining room, With private porches, ground floor laundry, shared backyard, off-street parking and barn. Additional FAR available on .1550 acre lot.
